LESSON: THE CALL OF DISCIPLES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.1: The Call of Disciples

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The Call of Disciples
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How did the disciples respond to the call of Jesus Christ?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures
2. state how different people are called to serve God today

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures

Teach
• Today’s focus: retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures” using a school example.
• Model B for “retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: state how different people are called to serve God today

Teach
• Today’s focus: state how different people are called to serve God today.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “state how different people are called to serve God today” using a school example.
• Model B for “state how different people are called to serve God today” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "state how different people are called to serve God today" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures
• Model 2: state how different people are called to serve God today

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures
2. Practise: state how different people are called to serve God today

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for The Call of Disciples.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did the disciples respond to the call of Jesus Christ?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures
• state how different people are called to serve God today

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
